scope.permitted_inputs: unchanged frozen token features and entity role tags; no evaluation labels in model inputs
scope.exposure: validation and official test already exposed; discovery only, not independent confirmation

comparator.cohort: exact completed four routing variants plus three terminal-scattering variants
comparator.strength: strongest measured within this exact cohort; strongest across all historical common-protocol baselines not certified here

valid.bound_kind: label-aware empirical oracle with zero F1 for absent class; not model/input attainable

test.bound_kind: label-aware empirical oracle with zero F1 for absent class; not model/input attainable

mechanism_addressable_gap: unresolved; a label oracle upper bound is not task-specific attainable gain
formal_readiness: exploratory_only: linked qualified dataset and completed full common-protocol baseline cohort records still need location, not a request to rerun baselines
decision: Enough nonzero upper room for bounded source/math investigation only. No repeated expensive optimization justified by this interval alone; current unmodified3DPP not promoted.
reassess_when: metric/labels/population/permitted inputs change, or stronger exact-protocol comparator is identified
